data.body: 549b review #2 (against remediated 7949 material) still BLOCKed on 3 NEW findings: E2 (manifest had no serialization format), G6 (no-fire candidate norm_id source unspecified), G7 (no-fire direction redefined the epic's cohort/routed predicate). Resolved all three: manifest is now JSONL (sorted keys, rank order); no-fire candidates keyed (C, norm_id=None); no-fire admitted ONLY under the epic's predicate (C in some finding's cohort on the plan AND no finding cites C, missing-cohort skipped), consensus only RAISES to advisory. Also addressed blocking project.portability advisory: vintage-gate git-log resolves against gate_source.default_ref and fails closed to no-committed-prompt-history when the base ref is absent/errs. Final 7953 chars, description_warning null. Initial auto-push to origin/tickets hit a concurrent-writer race; resolved via push recovery. Relaunching review #3.
